FAQ

Questions We Get Asked
(And Our Honest Answers)

  • How quickly can you deliver my website/app?

    Starter packages: 2 weeks. Professional packages: 3-4 weeks. Enterprise/custom solutions: 4-8 weeks depending on complexity. We can fast-track for urgent projects (extra fees apply).

    The timeline depends on how quickly you provide content (photos, menu, text). We'll give you a detailed project timeline on our discovery call.

  • Do I need technical knowledge to manage the system?

    Absolutely not. We design everything to be brain-dead simple. If you can use Facebook or WhatsApp, you can manage your website/app.

    Plus, we provide full training for you and your staff, along with video tutorials and documentation. And if you ever get stuck, our support team is one message away.

  • What if I don't like the design?

    That's why we offer unlimited revisions on Professional and Enterprise packages (2 rounds on Starter). You'll see mockups before we build anything, and we'll iterate until you're 100% happy.

    Our job is to make your restaurant look amazing online. We won't stop until we get it right.

  • Can you integrate with my existing POS or management system?

    In most cases, yes. We've integrated with dozens of POS systems (Toast, Square, Lightspeed, Revel, etc.) and management platforms.

    If your system has an API, we can connect it. We'll confirm compatibility during our discovery call.

  • What happens after the project is delivered?

    You're not abandoned. Every package includes post-launch support (duration varies by package). After that, you can choose a monthly support plan or handle updates yourself.

    We also monitor performance and provide optimization recommendations to help you get the most out of your investment.

  • Why are you more expensive than Wix or Squarespace?

    Because Wix won't cut your delivery app fees by €50K/year. Squarespace won't build you a loyalty program that drives repeat customers. Those are DIY tools—fine for blogs, terrible for restaurants.

    We build custom business systems designed specifically for restaurants. It's the difference between a €20 knife from IKEA and a €200 chef's knife—both cut, but one is built for professionals.
